svg.title: Mac — Advanced and diagnostics
svg.desc: Original static settings design. Synthetic labels and source-default previews only; no runtime queries, audio, configuration writes or app behavior.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, SF Pro Text, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Every supported key stays discoverable, with its scope, authority and activation rule.
Effective state not queried. Proposed controls require supported host capabilities.
Find config keys, environment aliases, CLI actions and app preferences from any app.
A saved file is not proof the running host or child adopted it.
Preview the before/after diff and choose Save for later or explicit activation.
Host-side validation; an explicit guarded restart can disconnect every client.
A phone selects authorized host resources; it never opens a Mac path locally.
Replaces an active child; a short part of audio can be missed. Never starts idle listening.
Model paths, consent and request budgets stay separate. No download on screen entry.
Default off. Bounded enumerated events only; off clears unsent local events.
App opt-in is separate from host collection.
Read status first. No automatic recovery, capture, provider login or private output fallback.
Secrets set/unset only; omit identities, endpoints, bindings and speech content.
Choose fields and see exact defaults. Reset never re-arms capture or expands permissions.
Every inventory member belongs to a typed editor, action, invariant or explained unavailable
Continue in All settings for every field, source and prerequisite. This frame shows representative controls.
STATIC DESIGN · representative category content · synthetic labels · no runtime effects
